cases.name: happy_path_whysimilar
cases.description: Strong evidence + valid LLM citations → narrative kind.

cases.name: happy_path_creatoradvice_evidence_only
cases.description: creatorAdvice with NO MIR criteria, grounded on shared descriptors → narrative with empty citations (the evidence/acoustic fallback added for our MIR-less catalog).

cases.name: hallucinated_artist_fact
cases.description: Narrative v2: LLM asserts a location NOT in artistKnowledge → rejected as fact-hallucinated (the integrity gate extended from numbers to artist facts).

cases.name: happy_path_creatoradvice
cases.description: Same context, different mode → creator advice narrative.

cases.name: happy_path_high_cosine_low_agreement
cases.description: Cosine >= 0.75 passes the gate even when criteria agreements are weak.

cases.name: low_context_missing_criteria
cases.description: Empty criteria list → gate short-circuits before LLM call.

cases.name: low_context_missing_title
cases.description: Title is empty → gate short-circuits as missing-metadata.

cases.name: low_context_weak_evidence
cases.description: All criteria agreement below 0.55 AND raw cosine below 0.75 → weak-evidence.

cases.name: hallucinated_unknown_criterion
cases.description: LLM cites a criterion not present in the context → validation rejects.

cases.name: hallucinated_wrong_trackid
cases.description: LLM cites a different trackId than the one in context → rejected.

cases.name: hallucinated_wrong_tempo_value
cases.description: Cited tempo value differs from context by > 2 BPM → rejected.

cases.name: hallucinated_timestamp_outside_window
cases.description: Cited timestampRange is outside the side-appropriate window → rejected.

cases.name: malformed_schema
cases.description: LLM emits JSON that doesn't match NarrativeResponse schema → rejected.

cases.name: openai_returns_none
cases.description: SDK helper returns None on transient failure → unavailable openai-error.

cases.name: happy_path_artist_resonates
cases.description: Artist-framed: grounded 'why this artist resonates' over a CC (Jamendo) match + valid citations -> narrative.

cases.name: hallucinated_artist_criterion
cases.description: Artist-framed narrative cites a criterion (timbre) not in the context -> validation rejects.

cases.name: empty_timestamp_range_on_mirless_match
cases.description: Regression (was a deterministic whySimilar 500): a MIR-less match (criteria=[]) with a strong cosine gets a citation whose timestampRange is []. The length guard in _timestamp_is_grounded rejects it as citation-hallucinated instead of throwing ValueError('not enough values to unpack').

cases.name: happy_path_whysimilar_mirless_evidence
cases.description: The common MIR-less whySimilar match: criteria=[] but real shared genre descriptors + artistKnowledge (location, genres). The model grounds prose on tags + artist facts + the matched moment and emits citations=[] with a grounded location factCitation -> narrative. Locks in that the empty-criteria happy path is a valid narrative, not a fallback.

cases.name: prose_ungrounded_bpm_on_mirless_whysimilar
cases.description: Hard backstop: a MIR-less whySimilar match (criteria=[]) whose FREE PROSE states a tempo (129 BPM) has no validated criterion to back it, so the number is a fabrication. The prose-numeric backstop rejects it as prose-ungrounded-metric (never rendered). Fires ONLY for whySimilar + empty criteria; craft modes and criteria-present whySimilar are untouched.
